reason: KRX_CLOSE_SOURCE_MISMATCH; original recovery deadline expired before this investigation

rootCause.collector: Any KRX observation at or after 15:30 bypassed stale-quote rejection; 19:56 after-hours observations and ranking values were wrongly accepted as regular-session closing data.
rootCause.publication: No reviewed original-edition draft existed. No 20:10 publication execution was present in the inspected latest Actions runs; the exact reason the scheduled execution did not appear is unconfirmed.

changes.regularClose: 20:10 collection and draft validation require actual 15:30 closing-minute observations. Collector additionally requires ranking/detail amount and change-rate agreement. Missing close values block collection; no timestamp relabel or numerical substitution.
changes.handoff: Successful server collection triggers the publisher watcher using the original request pinned to the collection run head commit. Probe mode never starts publication.
changes.conflicts: Watcher rechecks root/archive/index after Git 409/422 until the original deadline.

remainingLimitation: The current source was not demonstrated to supply a verified complete regular-session closing top-100 feed. Such data remains blocked; these changes do not claim that a correct 20:10 source feed has been obtained.
